msg: There are 8 possible gnome colours. There are two possible basket colours: red or yellow. Gnomes are grouped with baskets: Red basket = pink, brown, purple, red gnomes. Yellow basket = yellow, orange, blue, green gnomes.A basket will go through phases of lots of mushrooms to few mushrooms. When a basket is giving lots of mushrooms (generally more than 3) you want to stick with that basket! To do this, keep choosing the colour gnomes in that basket group. I.e., pink, brown, purple, red gnomes for the red basket. Once the basket is giving 3 or less, switch to the other colour by choosing the other group of gnomes. Stay with this basket colour now. Repeat as needed.Top tip: think "pink, brown, purple, red" in your head constantly to remind yourself which gnomes to pick. Then think "not pink, brown, purple, red" once you switch baskets.
